status: NON-GOVERNING SANDBOX. Not canon, not engineering authority. Wayfarer is the calibration ship; every coefficient is derived from its seed ledger at run time.

payload_aboard_t.note: kT 2026-10-24: reference ship flies with an empty hold for now. Canon identity 858.5 t dry + 300 t fluid = 1,158.5 t wet has no payload line; the canon question itself stays open and is not settled by this sandbox.

design_mode.source: torch mode cards give exactly 1 g at reference wet mass in CRUISE

habitation_life_support.why: people need habitat and life support

armor_fixed_shield.why: forward armor wraps the habitat, so it follows crew size

structure.why: frames and tank shells carry the loaded ship

propulsion.why: reactor, torch and nozzle follow thrust

relational_plant.why: fixed 88 t plant if the hull flies Metric, otherwise none

planetary_launch.why: fixed launch if carried, otherwise none

engineering_reserve.why: reserve kept as the same share of dry mass
